content: Human-labeling session — def-while-building:easy seed 1. Objective: An enemy rush — three riflemen and two heavy tanks — is already closing on your base at (10,20); the column is staged at x=45 and reaches the yard in about four turns. Your base — yard, refinery, barracks, power plant, four medium tanks at (14, 18-22) — is in place; the medium tanks stand on HOLD-FIRE orders (they will not engage on their own, even when shot at). Budget $1800 (pillboxes are anti-infantry — they barely scratch heavy tanks). Four kills, three pillboxes built, yard intact, within about 60 turns.
